description: This file defines the MyInfoAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for retrieving the authenticated employee's personal information within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It uses OpenAPI annotations for documentation and relies on various traits, models, and services for its functionality.

classes.name: MyInfoAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint to retrieve personal information of the authenticated employee, supporting different response models based on query parameter.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current employee's details, returning the data in a model determined by the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request, particularly the 'model' parameter with permitted values.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines which data model class to use based on the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to handle updates to employee info.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Not implemented; would provide validation rules for updates.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; would handle deletion if applicable.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; would validate delete operations.
